exports.vertexEmbeddingAdapter: embed({ model, body, credentials, signal, log }) -> core result with response/accounting or error/acceptedJob; buildUrl/buildBody introspection
exports.createVertexEmbeddingAdapter: factory({ timeoutMs, fetch }); fetch is the network boundary only
exports.buildVertexEmbeddingPlan: (model, body) -> model, itemCount, dimensions, body, bodies
exports.mapVertexEmbeddingResponse: (raw, plan) -> OpenAI list; validates count, width, finite values
exports.vertexEmbeddingUrl: (validated scope, validated model) -> fixed Google predict URL
exports.vertexEmbeddingAcceptedJob: (result, jobState) -> result with unknown-cost no-replay marker

auth: explicit service_account JSON in selected credentials.apiKey
provider.locationMigration: location wins only when region absent or equal; conflicting non-empty values fail. Default us-central1. Project is SA project_id; conflicting projectId fails.
provider.host: source getVertexHost: eu -> aiplatform.eu.rep.googleapis.com; all regional locations and global -> aiplatform.googleapis.com (not Veo regional host)

request.input: 1..250 non-empty strings; no token arrays, structured or multimodal inputs
request.dimensions: optional positive JSON safe integer, forwarded as outputDimensionality; no inferred model-specific upper bound
request.batch: one predict for text models; one sequential predict per Gemini input
request.encoding: float or locally packed little-endian float32 base64; never forwarded

response: predictions[].embeddings.values -> ordered OpenAI list; finite/count/width checked. No source estimated tokens: public zero placeholders, accounting usageMissing=true and unknown cost. Source model echo: bare body.model if supplied, otherwise vertex/resolved-model.
errors: no upstream body, token, JSON or secret is exposed; manual redirects; one deadline including mint/body/batch. Postsubmit 5xx/timeout/abort/unusable 2xx and all failures after any successful batch part carry acceptedJob. Never retry or replay.

activationTargets.change: import vertexEmbeddingAdapter and map existing vertex identity; never generic OpenAI compatibility
existing adapter.embed branch is sufficient; retain no shared refresh/retry
persist acceptedJob as unknown cost on selected account and stop account fallback; prerequisite to activation
append three embedding-kind rows, preserve all existing identity/aliases/models and kinds; no price guesses
verify static embedding discovery and location migration; no guessed live discovery
document SA-only embeddings, input and batch semantics, location migration and unknown usage
